name: test_intake_directory_contains_only_the_four_user_supplied_pdfs
description:
Objective: Intake directory contains only the four user supplied pdfs.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/application/test_canonical_intake_documents.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `validate_canonical_directory` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `[path.name for path in validate_canonical_directory(INTAKE_ROOT, manifest=CANONICAL_DOCUMENTS, max_bytes=MAX_APPLICATION_UPLOAD_BYTES)] == list(CANONICAL_DOCUMENTS)`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Intake directory contains only the four user supplied pdfs.
2. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `[path.name for path in validate_canonical_directory(INTAKE_ROOT, manifest=CANONICAL_DOCUMENTS, max_bytes=MAX_APPLICATION_UPLOAD_BYTES)] == list(CANONICAL_DOCUMENTS)`.
3. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
